sourceTitle: Mom’s No Bake Chocolate Peanut Butter Coconut Cookies
sourceText:
Mom’s No Bake Chocolate Peanut Butter Coconut Cookies
By: Ken & Patti Fisher
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:00pm

Ingredients




Part 1
1/4 cup Cocoa
2 cups Granulated Sugar
1/2 cup Butter
1/2 cup Milk
1 teaspoon Vanilla
Part 2
1 cup Peanut Butter
1 1/2 cups Coconut
3 cups Quick Oatmeal

Preparation

1 Part 1: 2 Stir under low heat to melt part 1 ingredients then bring to boil for one minuet. Remove from heat. 3 Part 2: 4 Mix in Part 2 ingredients and drop spoon full onto wax paper. 5 Let cool until firm.

About


Mom made these for me every year at Christmas…
Even after I went into the Army…
She knew how much I loved them…
I make them myself now in her memory…
Enjoy,
Ken & Patti
In Loving Memory
Pebble Jean Fisher
